name: Густое масло, атмосферная глубина
about: Плотный мазок, лессировки, огромное небо и воздух между планами. Фигура мелкая, масштаб задаёт пейзаж. Романтическая живопись, а не концепт-арт.
style_notes_en: thick impasto oil with glazed transparent darks, a great open expanse above the figures — sky, vault or shaft, whatever the place actually offers — taking much of the frame, layered atmospheric perspective with visible air between planes, figures small against the scale of the place, romantic painting logic rather than concept art, visible canvas weave
palette_en: Middle key: the picture reads at middle brightness and is not a dark painting — deep shadow is held to about a fifth of the frame and there is lit air between the planes. Warm earth near at hand — ochre, umber, brick — against a distance that stays genuinely blue and keeps its colour instead of going black.
